newsitem.title: USA: Mediqual Systems IPO postponed - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Mediqual Systems IPO postponed - underwriter.

text.p: The initial public offering of 2.2 million common shares of Mediqual Systems Inc has been "postponed indefinitely due to market conditions," lead underwriter for the deal Hambrecht & Quist Inc said Monday.
The Westborough, Mass.-based supplier of clinical information management systems and services to the health care industry, was expected to price between $9 and $11 a share this week.

A syndicate representative at Hambrecht said he did not know whether the deal would resurface. The company originally filed to trade on the Nasdaq National Market under the symbol "MDQL," but switched to the American Exchange under "MQV."
